name: Prussian Confederation
alt: Prussian estates against the Teutonic Order

predecessors.name: Teutonic Order
predecessors.text: western Prussia: Gdańsk Pomerania, Chełmno Land, the region of Elbing and Marienburg

successors.name: House of Jagiellon
successors.text: the regions that 'formed the new Polish province of Royal Prussia'

ledger.x: February 1454: the Prussian Confederation rises against the Teutonic Order.
February-March 1454: the Confederation and the Order fight for western Prussia.
March 1454: the Confederation puts itself under the Polish crown.
19 October 1466: the Second Peace of Thorn ends the war.
19 October 1466: the client status ends when the land becomes the Polish province of Royal Prussia.
October 1466: the Confederation ends; its lands become Royal Prussia.

wars.name: Thirteen Years' War
wars.outcome: Second Peace of Thorn, 19 October 1466: the Order renounced Gdańsk Pomerania and Chełmno Land, Elbing, Marienburg and Warmia were recognised as part of Poland, and the Confederation's land formed Royal Prussia.

certainty.note: A moving front; no page opened gives the Confederation's frontier in any one year, and the Thirteen Years' War page records cities changing hands.
